ARA Software Engineer Intern | 
Florida Polytechnic University Alumni
profile.summary: Recent graduate from Florida Polytechnic University. Currently holding a M.S. and B.S. in Computer Science with a concentration in Game Development. Interning at Applied Research Associates as a Software Engineer. Proficient in many high-level languages like C++, Java, Python, and Rust.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Software Engineer intern working in Rust environments. Working with Docker and Kubernetes. Collaborating with other engineers to create and debug features

positions.description: A teacher's assistant for Computational Linear Algebra

honors.description: Awarded by Bright Futures for high academic achievement and 75 volunteer hours.

volunteerExperiences.description: I helped upkeep the main building and made sure the animals had a clean and healthy environment by providing food, water, exercise, and bedding.
I went to the Feeding Tampa Bay warehouse to organize food to be sent to those in need.
